items.name: Spec Compliance
items.note: Spec project, checklist (beside the package), report template, no-defaults refusal, optional workdir, env file with source record, auth copy with guaranteed delete, idle abort and CI checks all present; no ci.yml edit.

items.name: Error Handling
items.note: Refusal messages name the missing input; report and login cleanup run on every exit path via one idempotent Shutdown; screenshot failure is noted, not thrown.

items.name: Security Basics
items.note: No token or credential content reaches the report; fixed argv for every child process; child env stripped of CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR; stale copies scrubbed; key tail removed at shutdown; exposure documented.

items.name: Test Quality
items.note: 15 browser-free Playwright unit checks (config, auth, provisioning, shutdown, scrub, child env, report, idle, chat checks, file checks) plus 7 pytest checks including a negative case per hard check family.

items.name: Performance Basics
items.note: Polling every 15 s, file walk bounded to 5000 files.

items.name: Naming & Structure
items.note: Every .ts file well under 300 lines (pinned by pytest); modules split by concern.

items.name: Affected Boundaries
items.note: Producer: fixture package and chat-map/screen-map; consumer: this project. Real probes: verify_package against the recorded hash, the dry harness, and chat checks against a faithful and a broken fake app. The real WebUI and agent boundary is operator acceptance.
